adapter_exceptions.accounts.status: Human CLI uses native login status; structured transports observe unverified local cache only.
adapter_exceptions.history.search/read/resume: Native MCP additionally verifies caller_thread_id; API/OAuth use scoped grants.
adapter_exceptions.resume: ACCOUNT selects local conversation reopening; bare resume retains existing emergency-pause controls outside the shortcut contract.
adapter_exceptions.local_cli: Host operator admission differs from scoped remote authorization; no implicit remote privilege.
adapter_exceptions.tabs: Same-user local CLI resolves pins; API/MCP retain explicit pins and scoped authority. Raw input/capture and unsupported runtime/backends remain held. tabs result aliases common operations.result locally.
adapter_exceptions.local_controller: Automatic same-user private connection; external OAuth connector grants are separate.

selected_profile_create.reason: Use --profile with an existing account selector/alias; requires the qualified selected-profile launch owner. Windows profile creation remains unsupported; no shell fallback or account substitution.

workspace_recovery.reason: Exact saved conversation identity is required. With --restore-layout, qualified single local interactive shell slots are preserved in separate tabs before coding views resume in their saved positions; busy, pinned or unknown slots hold.

exact_grok_tui_health.reason: Grok ACP activity does not prove arbitrary foreground TUI responsiveness.

cross_backend.reason: Exact saved Codex conversation reattachment requires a qualified destination bridge/profile; unsupported continuity preserves the source.

result.reason: tabs result --request-id reads local UID-owned common journal; remote callers use operations.result.
